name: FANToM
description: FANToM is a benchmark designed to stress-test machine Theory of Mind (ToM) capabilities in interactive, information-asymmetric conversational contexts through question answering. It includes multiple question types that require underlying reasoning to detect illusory or false ToM capabilities in large language models.
reputation: A recent and increasingly cited benchmark for theory-of-mind evaluation, especially for probing false-positive ToM behavior in LLMs.
notes: Focuses on interactive ToM evaluation rather than passive narratives; challenging for state-of-the-art LLMs.
